args.rationale: Straight girder bridge, 2D spine beam model with elastic beam-column elements.
10 spans, precast simply supported then made continuous; no pier column geometry given so supports are bearings on rigid supports -> continuous.
Integrated small box section second moment of area.
4 precast girders merged into a single spine beam: A_single * 4.
C50 concrete modulus from JTG 3362 Table 3.1.5 (no override given).
Prestressed concrete unit weight, upper limit 26.0 kN/m3.
Three design lanes stated; one-way traffic, carriageway 11.5 m.
Class I uniform lane load 10.5 kN/m.
Transverse lane load factor for 3 lanes per JTG D60-2015 Table 4.3.1-5.
Abutment 0: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric, 2 per girder end x 4 girders = 8.
Plain elastomeric fixed: longitudinal spring Kh.
Plain elastomeric fixed: longitudinal spring Kh.

args.summary:
Modelled the bridge as a 2D spine-beam (MR-01) of 10 equal 25 m spans, precast girders made continuous (system "continuous", MR-05; no pier column geometry given, so piers are rigid supports with bearings).

Girder: small-box precast prestressed C50, 4 girders/span merged into one spine beam. Section integration gave A_single = 1.0605 m^2, I_single = 0.25166 m^4; combined A = 4.2421 m^2, I = 1.00663 m^4 (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5), gamma = 26.0 kN/m^3 (JTG D60 4.2.1), w = 110.29 kN/m, m = 11.243 t/m (MR-07). Dead load = girder self-weight only.

Bearings: 8 per support line (2 per girder end). Supports 0-4, 7-10 and abutments PTFE sliding elastomeric (longitudinal free, Kh=0, dofs vertical spring); Piers 5 and 6 plain elastomeric fixed (longitudinal spring, Kh=26250 kN/m). All: S = 10.096, Kv = 11.33e6 kN/m (JTG 3362 8.7).

Live load: Highway Class I, 3 lanes, qk = 10.5 kN/m, xi = 0.78, Pk = 310 kN in every span. f1 = 4.415 Hz from modal analysis, giving mu = 0.2467 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Model ran successfully: self-weight support reactions range 1088 kN (abutments) to 3125 kN, max lane live-load positive moment 6410 kNm.
